case_descriptions.empty-readiness: Actual bound standalone child becomes ready with empty catalogs.
case_descriptions.dormant-catalog: Small dormant catalog uses no guest preparation before invocation; this is not a scale result.
case_descriptions.fresh-store: Repeated small guest execution receives fresh store state, including a repeated bump on the same scheduled cell after its earlier bump mutation.
case_descriptions.mixed-outcomes: Success, declared guest error and trap preserve distinct terminal outcomes.
case_descriptions.deadline: A bounded expired or running deadline terminates through the supported invocation path.
case_descriptions.cancellation: Explicit cancellation and scoped status settle a known activation without reinvocation.
case_descriptions.malformed-input: Malformed typed input is rejected without successful guest execution.
case_descriptions.memory-budget: A small configured memory boundary is enforced.
case_descriptions.fuel-budget: A finite positive fuel grant is exhausted by a small noncooperative guest; its retained resource-limit outcome and final accounting match the response.
case_descriptions.persistent-wall-ceiling: Node and deployment relative wall-time ceilings remain valid after wall-clock passage beyond their configured durations, preserve stored policy, and combine with an earlier caller absolute deadline.
case_descriptions.log-budget: The supplied activation log budget governs emitted guest logs.
case_descriptions.capability-context: Context, remaining-budget and clock/log fixture observations use the current activation.
case_descriptions.tenant-isolation: Two explicit tenants retain scoped releases and activation observations.
case_descriptions.route-update: A running activation retains its old revision while a same-release policy update creates a new revision observed by a later activation; the old owner is then cancelled and policy restored.
case_descriptions.queue-admission: Two running cells plus three queued owners remain bounded; overflow is rejected. After the first same-tenant waiter runs, the other tenant completes while the second holder and second same-tenant spin are still running, before either is cancelled or terminates. Accepted cancellation and retained accounting settle all owners; this is a bounded fairness witness, not a calibrated fairness result.
case_descriptions.healthy-recovery: A healthy activation succeeds after the selected failures.
case_descriptions.child-resources: Bounded samples of the retained child PID corroborate tiny topology and resource ownership; RSS is only an observation.
case_descriptions.clean-shutdown: The real child reports zero transient owners, flushes telemetry, joins its helper and is reaped.
case_descriptions.adapter-rpc-parity: Eight outcome pairs plus capabilities snapshot, live-budget/log and clock pairs compare direct adapter and real RPC. A single reused cell, same-service releases under two tenants, and actual correlated logs/spans verify context, trace, accounting and tenant association without equating distinct identities or clock values.
